verified_behaviors: one active task and at most three pending
concurrent duplicate IDs execute once and preserve original content
task state, terminal retention marker and lifecycle event commit together
migration SQL or version-marker failure rolls back schema and data
restart cancels queued tasks and leaves dispatched effects unknown without replay
authenticated ordered replay and live delivery use one durable log
205-event paginated replay and handover do not create tasks or actions
dashboard refresh and reconnect do not submit or approve
raw argument bodies use restricted payload storage rather than audit metadata
limits: Existing task retention bounds request-ID lifetime
Queued commands are cancelled, not automatically resumed, on restart
No new hardware, public-site or two-hour soak qualification
